title: canonJAM: Canonicalization of JAM strings for duplicate detection
description: Python library that replaces the pairwise duplicate-detection step of JAM (O(m²)) with a dictionary of canonical keys (O(m)). Implements the symmetry group for all 8 JAM options, provides both the literal computation of the canonical key (minimum over the 12 group elements) and the optimal computation in O(k) with constant 2 via column sorting, and validates that both produce exactly the same equivalence classes as the original algorithm.
